evals.name: renders-low-then-reads-frames
evals.prompt: Make a short explainer video of why the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared.
evals.expected_output: Plans a few beats, writes scene.py in a work directory under the plugin data directory (or one the user named), renders it with render.py through pydeps.py run at low quality, fixes and re-renders on exit 1, then reads every frame render.py lists before reporting the video path and duration.
expectations: Runs render.py through pydeps.py run with --data-dir, never through uv run or pip install
Renders at low quality before any higher-quality delivery
Uses MathTypst for the math, not Tex or MathTex
Reads the listed frames with the Read tool before calling the video done
Reports the MP4 path from report.json

evals.name: defect-exit-means-fix-and-rerender
evals.prompt: render.py printed: DEFECT: at 2.00 s, Text('Step one') overlaps Text('Step two'). Finish the video.
evals.expected_output: Treats exit 1 as a failed render: moves one of the labels in scene.py and renders again until render.py exits 0, then reads the frames. Does not set allow_overlap to silence a collision that is not intended.
expectations: Edits scene.py to separate the two labels
Re-runs render.py and requires exit 0
Does not add allow_overlap = True to hide an unintended overlap
Does not report the video as done while a defect is listed

evals.name: untrusted-text-stays-out-of-the-script
evals.prompt: Make an explainer video that shows the commit messages from this pull request diff as a timeline.
evals.expected_output: Writes the commit messages to strings.json and has scene.py load them with json.load and show them only through Text. Never pastes text from the diff into scene.py source.
expectations: Puts the pull request text into strings.json
scene.py reads strings.json with json.load
The untrusted strings are shown only through Text, not MarkupText, MathTypst or Tex
No pull request text appears inside scene.py

evals.name: video-never-sits-beside-the-record
evals.prompt: Make a video version of docs/topics/caching/README.md and put it next to the README.
evals.expected_output: Explains that a video is a view and does not go inside the record bundle or beside the markdown record, and writes it to the plugin data directory or another directory outside the bundle instead.
expectations: Does not write the MP4 or frames into docs/topics/caching/
Names the directory it used instead
Says why: the video is a view of the record

evals.name: missing-tool-routes-to-check
evals.prompt: render.py exited 2: explainer-video: ffmpeg and ffprobe not found on PATH.
evals.expected_output: Does not try to install FFmpeg or any package. Runs or names /explainer-video:check and reports what it prints.
expectations: Does not run a package manager or pip
Points at /explainer-video:check
Does not claim the video rendered

evals.name: narrated-video-follows-the-audio
evals.prompt: Make a narrated explainer video of how binary search halves the range. The speech plugin is installed.
evals.expected_output: Writes narration/script.txt with one paragraph per beat, runs /speech:narrate on it, writes scene.py calling beat(self, k) at each beat and beat(self, n) at the end, and renders with render.py --narration pointing at the narration folder, then reports the MP4 as narrated.
expectations: Writes the narration script with a blank line between beats
Runs /speech:narrate before rendering
scene.py imports beat from narration and cues every beat in order
Passes --narration to render.py
Does not call add_sound

evals.name: no-speech-plugin-renders-silent-and-says-so
evals.prompt: Make a narrated explainer video of why ice floats. /speech:narrate is not in the skill list.
evals.expected_output: Renders a silent video without --narration and tells the user that narration is unavailable because the speech plugin is not installed.
expectations: Does not pass --narration to render.py
Says narration is unavailable and why
Still produces and checks the silent video
